title: AppArmor Profile Compilation via apparmor_parser
author: Elastic
description:
Detects the execution of "apparmor_parser" using the "-o" option to write a compiled AppArmor
profile to an output file. This functionality is normally used by system administration tools
or package installation scripts when building or loading AppArmor policies. In adversarial
scenarios, attackers may use "apparmor_parser" to compile custom AppArmor profiles that can
later be loaded into the kernel through AppArmor policy management interfaces. Malicious
profiles may weaken security controls, alter the behavior of privileged programs, or assist in
exploitation chains involving AppArmor policy manipulation.
